svg.title: Customer support: tiered escalation
svg.desc: The customer reports an issue and L1 creates a ticket and troubleshoots it with a runbook. Issues resolved at L1 are confirmed with the customer. Unresolved issues escalate to L2 under a response SLA. L2 investigates; product defects go to engineering for a fix and release, other issues get a workaround. The customer confirms the resolution and the ticket closes.
svg.text: A customer issue is handled at L1, escalated to L2 when unresolved, and to engineering for product defects.
Illustrative process. Lanes are roles; steps, thresholds and timings are examples, not policy.
